android_mechanism: Unchanged items re-processed (rehashed) on every refresh; fix skips unchanged items cheaply
bug_description: insertArticle detects duplicates by letting the UNIQUE(feed_id, guid) constraint fail and catching the thrown exception ('Duplicate entry, ignore'). Every feed refresh re-attempts inserts for ALL previously seen articles — each one a full insert attempt that ends in a constraint-violation exception (statement execution + error object construction + catch), multiplying refresh cost with stored article count.
fix_summary: Inserts run with ConflictResolution.ON_CONFLICT_IGNORE so SQLite silently skips duplicates without exception overhead; behavior (only new articles stored) is unchanged.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: 12.8G vs 4.92G instructions (2.6x) over the no-op refresh phase

mechanism_oracle.definition: CPU time across the no-op refresh case window, from trace.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed pays statement-execution + exception-throw/catch per stored article; fixed pays a cheap ignored insert. unfixed no-op refresh CPU > fixed by a clear margin scaling with stored article count.

reproduction: git -C hosts/sheafreader checkout case/sheafreader_insert_duplicate_exception/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/sheafreader checkout case/sheafreader_insert_duplicate_exception/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
